================================================================================
Here-string after a file redirect
================================================================================

tee -a $c >/dev/null <<<"x $y"

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (redirected_statement
    (command
      (command_name
        (word))
      (word)
      (simple_expansion
        (variable_name)))
    (file_redirect
      (word))
    (herestring_redirect
      (string
        (string_content)
        (simple_expansion
          (variable_name))))))

================================================================================
Here-string after several redirects
================================================================================

cat 2>&1 <<<x
cat >f <<<x >g

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (redirected_statement
    (command
      (command_name
        (word)))
    (file_redirect
      (file_descriptor)
      (number))
    (herestring_redirect
      (word)))
  (redirected_statement
    (command
      (command_name
        (word)))
    (file_redirect
      (word))
    (herestring_redirect
      (word))
    (file_redirect
      (word))))

================================================================================

================================================================================

exec 0<> "${o}/fake-stdin"
exec 3<>file

          (variable_name))

================================================================================
Assignment followed by a redirect
================================================================================

Y+=" b" 2>/dev/null
Y=a >f

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (redirected_statement
    (variable_assignment
      (variable_name)
      (string
        (string_content)))
    (file_redirect
      (file_descriptor)
      (word)))
  (redirected_statement
    (variable_assignment
      (variable_name)
      (word))
    (file_redirect
      (word))))

================================================================================
Assignment with a redirect in a list
================================================================================

Y="a" && Y+=" b" 2>/dev/null

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program

        (string_content)))

      (variable_assignment
        (variable_name)

          (string_content)))

        (file_descriptor)
        (word)))))
